title: Trace flags and levels
description:
Filter trace messages by level and by flag, the way WPP and ETW tracing do.

```
enabled: level WARNING, flags IOCTL|POWER
TRACE(ERROR, IOCTL, "bad length")   -> shown
TRACE(INFO, IOCTL, "request 7")     -> hidden (level)
TRACE(ERROR, PNP, "start failed")   -> hidden (flag)
```
hints: `#define TRACE(lvl, flg, ...) do { if ((lvl) <= g_level && (g_flags & (flg))) std::printf(__VA_ARGS__); } while (0)` (lesson 4.02).
The `do { } while (0)` wrapper makes the macro behave like one statement after an `if`.
requirements: Levels 1 (critical) to 5 (verbose); a message shows when its level is at most the enabled level and its flag is enabled.
A `TRACE(level, flag, ...)` macro that does no formatting work when the message is hidden.
Change the enabled settings while running.
stretch: Add a per-message counter so you can see how often each line runs even while hidden.
